title: Navisworks Temporary Transform Governance
test_intent: Determine whether any temporary Navisworks transform used to continue coordination is explicitly governed and linked to corrective action in the source information.

applicability.applies_when: A Navisworks coordination container contains or relies on a manual translation, rotation, scale adjustment, or equivalent temporary alignment correction.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No temporary transform or equivalent alignment override is present.

required_evidence: identity of the affected source model or reference
description of the temporary transform or alignment override

result_logic.pass: Every temporary transform is documented, traceable to an affected source, associated with a governed exception and corrective action, and tracked toward removal or formal resolution.
result_logic.fail: A temporary transform is being used as an undocumented or permanent substitute for correction of the source coordinate/export condition.
result_logic.indeterminate: A transform appears to exist but available evidence cannot establish whether it is temporary, authorized, or linked to corrective action.

provenance.migration_note: Conformance object derived from the migrated requirement and source triage principle that coordinate errors are corrected at source rather than normalized through undocumented Navisworks transforms.
